events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — David Pastrnak scored twice to move past 400 goals for his career, and added an assist, as the Boston Bruins won their seventh consecutive game, 5-3 over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pastrnak scores twice, hits 400-goal milestone as Bruins beat Maple Leafs

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Joel Edmundson and Quinton Byfield each had a goal and an assist as the Los Angeles Kings scored three quick goals in the second period to beat the Montreal Canadiens 5-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kings score 3 quick goals in 2nd period and beat Canadiens 5-1

headlines.description: — Dallas scored three straight goals and Roope Hintz scored at 3:04 of overtime to lift the Stars over the Ottawa Senators 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hintz caps Stars’ comeback with overtime goal in 3-2 win over Senators

headlines.description: — Jakob Chychrun scored his 100th career goal, Alex Ovechkin got his 901st into the empty net and the Washington Capitals defeated the Carolina Hurricanes 4-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jakob Chychrun scores his 100th career goal, Ovechkin gets empty-netter as Capitals beat Hurricanes

events.name: Calgary Flames at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Nathan Walker scored the game-winning goal and Oskar Sundqvist added two assists, lifting the St. Louis Blues to a 3-2 victory over the Calgary Flames on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Walker, Binnington lead Blues to 3-2 win over Flames

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Minnesota Wild

headlines.description: — Collin Graf scored 2:41 into overtime and the surging San Jose Sharks came back to beat the Minnesota Wild 2-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Graf scores in OT as Sharks come back to beat Wild 2-1

headlines.description: — Gabriel Landeskog scored his first goal of the season, Nathan MacKinnon had three assists and the Colorado Avalanche beat the Anaheim Ducks 4-1 on Tuesday night in a matchup of the Western Conference’s points leaders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Landeskog scores first goal of season in Avalanche's 4-1 win over Ducks

headlines.description: — Josh Morrissey had a goal and two assists as the Winnipeg Jets beat the Vancouver Canucks 5-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Morrissey and Hellebuyck lead Jets past Canucks 5-3 to halt 3-game slide

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: — Charlie Coyle scored the winning goal in a shootout and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the Seattle Kraken 2-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Coyle scores shootout winner as Blue Jackets beat Kraken 2-1 to stop 4-game skid
